3	on:
4	  push:
5	    branches: [main, develop]
6	    paths-ignore:
7	      - "**/*.md"
8	      - "docs/**"
9	      - ".claude/**"
10	      - ".github/skills/**"
11	      - ".vscode/**"
12	      - ".cursor/**"

14	  workflow_dispatch:
15	    inputs:
16	      skip_e2e:
17	        description: "Skip E2E tests (faster deploy)"
18	        type: boolean
19	        default: false
20	      skip_tests:
21	        description: "Skip ALL tests (lint + typecheck still run)"
22	        type: boolean
23	        default: false
24	      skip_ci:
25	        description: "Skip entire CI — deploy immediately (emergency only)"
26	        type: boolean
27	        default: false

29	concurrency:
30	  group: deploy-coolify-${{ github.ref }}
31	  # Cancel superseded deploys. Coolify has a known stuck-build bug class
32	  # (coollabsio/coolify #5850, #6414, #6579) where overlapping Next.js
33	  # builds on the app server can wedge one build "In Progress" forever,
34	  # which in turn blocks Coolify's automatic Docker cleanup from running
35	  # and fills the disk. Cancelling in-flight deploys on a newer push is
36	  # safer than queueing them.
37	  cancel-in-progress: true
38	
39	# Explicit least-privilege permissions (security best practice)
40	permissions:

49	jobs:
50	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
51	  # Quality gate: lint + typecheck (always runs unless skip_ci)
52	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
53	  quality:
54	    name: Lint & Typecheck
55	    if: ${{ !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.skip_ci) }}
56	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
57	    timeout-minutes: 15
58	    steps:
59	      - name: Checkout repository

62	      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}

67	
68	      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)

73	
74	      - name: Lint

84	    name: Unit tests

86	      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&

88	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
89	    timeout-minutes: 15
90	    steps:
91	      - name: Checkout repository
92	        uses: actions/checkout@v7
93	
94	      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
95	        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
96	        with:
97	          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
98	          cache: yarn
99	
100	      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)

117	      github.ref_name == 'main' &&
118	      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
119	        (inputs.skip_e2e || inputs.skip_tests || inputs.skip_ci))
120	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
121	    timeout-minutes: 30
122	    steps:
123	      - name: Checkout repository
124	        uses: actions/checkout@v7
125	
126	      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
127	        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
128	        with:
129	          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}

131	
132	      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)

134	
135	      - name: Install dependencies

137	
138	      - name: Generate service worker and robots.txt (prebuild)
139	        env:
140	          BUILD_VERSION: ${{ github.sha }}
141	          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
142	          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat
143	        run: yarn prebuild
144	
145	      - name: Build Next.js application
146	        env:
147	          NODE_ENV: production
148	          HMAC_SECRET: ${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
149	          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
150	          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat
151	          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
152	        run: yarn build
153	
154	      - name: Install Playwright browsers
155	        run: npx playwright install chromium --with-deps
156	
157	      - name: Start Next.js server (background)
158	        run: |
159	          yarn start &
160	          echo $! > .next-server.pid
161	          echo "Started Next.js server with PID $(cat .next-server.pid)"
162	        env:
163	          NODE_ENV: production
164	          PORT: 3000
165	          E2E_TEST_MODE: "1"
166	          NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_TEST_MODE: "1"
167	          HMAC_SECRET: ${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
168	          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
169	          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat

172	      - name: Wait for server to be ready
173	        run: npx wait-on http://localhost:3000 --timeout 60000
174	
175	      - name: Sanity check robots.txt
176	        run: |
177	          set -euo pipefail
178	          robots="$(curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/robots.txt)"
179	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "allow: /" > /dev/null
180	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "disallow: /_next/" > /dev/null
181	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "disallow: /api/" > /dev/null
182	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "user-agent: gptbot" > /dev/null
183	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "sitemap: https://www.esdeveniments.cat/server-static-sitemap.xml" > /dev/null

186	      - name: Run E2E tests

188	        env:
189	          CI: true

191	
192	      - name: Stop Next.js server
193	        if: always()

201	      - name: Upload Playwright report (on failure)

210	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
211	  # Build the production image on a GitHub runner and push it to GHCR.
212	  # The heavy Next.js build used to run on the shared Coolify host and
213	  # starved prod of CPU during deploys; building here keeps it off-box.
214	  # Coolify then deploys this prebuilt image (Docker Image source).
215	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
216	  build-and-push:
217	    name: Build & push image
218	    needs: [quality, unit-tests, e2e-tests]
219	    # Build only when the CI jobs that ran passed (mirrors the deploy gate).
220	    if: >-
221	      always() &&
222	      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.skip_ci) &&
223	      (needs.quality.result == 'success' || needs.quality.result == 'skipped') &&
224	      (needs.unit-tests.result == 'success' || needs.unit-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
225	      (needs.e2e-tests.result == 'success' || needs.e2e-tests.result == 'skipped')
226	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
227	    timeout-minutes: 30
228	    permissions:
229	      contents: read
230	      packages: write
231	    # Environment-scoped secrets let the develop (staging) build inline its own
232	    # NEXT_PUBLIC_* values, overriding the repo-level prod defaults.
233	    environment:
234	      name: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'staging' }}
235	    steps:
236	      - name: Checkout repository
237	        uses: actions/checkout@v7
238	
239	      - name: Compute lowercase image name
240	        id: meta
241	        run: echo "image=ghcr.io/$(echo '${{ github.repository }}' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
242	
243	      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
244	        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
245	
246	      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
247	        uses: docker/login-action@v3
248	        with:
249	          registry: ghcr.io
250	          username: ${{ github.actor }}
251	          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
252	
253	      - name: Build and push image
254	        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
255	        with:
256	          context: .
257	          push: true
258	          tags: |
259	            ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}:${{ github.ref_name }}
260	            ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}:sha-${{ github.sha }}
261	          cache-from: type=gha
262	          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
263	          # NEXT_PUBLIC_* are inlined into the client bundle (public by design).
264	          # HMAC_SECRET / SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN are used only in the builder stage and
265	          # do not persist in the final runner image (multi-stage Dockerfile).
266	          build-args: |
267	            BUILD_VERSION=${{ github.sha }}
268	            NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
269	            NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL }}
270	            NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN }}
271	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS }}
272	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS }}
273	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION }}
274	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS }}
275	            NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY }}
276	            NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI }}
277	            NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY }}
278	            HMAC_SECRET=${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
279	            SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
280	            SENTRY_ORG=${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
281	            SENTRY_PROJECT=${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
282	
283	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
284	  # Deploy to Coolify (waits for whichever CI jobs actually ran)
285	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
286	  deploy:
287	    name: Deploy to Coolify
288	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
289	    needs: [quality, unit-tests, e2e-tests, build-and-push]
290	    # Run deploy if all non-skipped jobs succeeded.
291	    # `always()` lets us proceed when skipped jobs report as skipped (not failed).
292	    if: >-
293	      always() &&
294	      (needs.quality.result == 'success' || needs.quality.result == 'skipped') &&
295	      (needs.unit-tests.result == 'success' || needs.unit-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
296	      (needs.e2e-tests.result == 'success' || needs.e2e-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
297	      (needs.build-and-push.result == 'success' || needs.build-and-push.result == 'skipped')
298	    # 20 min = 15 min MAX_WAIT for Coolify build (prod Next.js + Docker rebuilds
299	    # run ~12 min) + ~5 min for webhook trigger, smoke tests, and runner overhead.
300	    timeout-minutes: 20
301	    # GitHub Environment enables protection rules, required reviewers, and environment-specific secrets
302	    environment:
303	      name: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'staging' }}
304	      url: ${{ env.DEPLOY_URL }}
305	
306	    steps:
307	      - name: Deployment mode summary
308	        run: |
309	          echo "## Deployment Mode" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
310	          echo "| Check | Status |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
311	          echo "|-------|--------|" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
312	          echo "| Quality (lint+typecheck) | ${{ needs.quality.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
313	          echo "| Unit tests | ${{ needs.unit-tests.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
314	          echo "| E2E tests | ${{ needs.e2e-tests.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
315	          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
316	          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
317	            echo "**Trigger:** Manual dispatch" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
318	            echo "- skip_e2e: ${{ inputs.skip_e2e }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
319	            echo "- skip_tests: ${{ inputs.skip_tests }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
320	            echo "- skip_ci: ${{ inputs.skip_ci }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
321	          else
322	            echo "**Trigger:** Push to ${{ github.ref_name }} ($([ '${{ github.ref_name }}' = 'main' ] && echo 'full CI' || echo 'lint+typecheck+unit'))" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
323	          fi
324	
325	      # Coolify's app config points at the floating `:main` registry tag. A
326	      # health-check-triggered container restart recreates the container
327	      # from whatever image is locally cached under that tag WITHOUT going
328	      # through this deploy pipeline — so a restart can silently resurrect
329	      # stale code hours after a correct deploy, with no CI run, webhook, or
330	      # API call to show for it. This happened on 2026-07-31: the RSC
331	      # cache-poisoning fix (0cdf6f8e) deployed correctly at 14:34 UTC, then
332	      # a restart at 19:01 UTC reverted it. Pinning to the immutable
333	      # `sha-<commit>` tag (already pushed by build-and-push, above) before
334	      # every deploy removes the floating tag a restart could resurrect.
335	      # See docs/incidents/2026-04-04-cloudflare-rsc-cache-poisoning.md.
336	      - name: Pin Coolify to this commit's immutable image tag
337	        # skip_ci (emergency deploy) also skips build-and-push above, so no
338	        # sha-<commit> image exists to pin to — leave whatever tag is already
339	        # configured alone and let the webhook redeploy it as-is.
340	        if: needs.build-and-push.result == 'success'
341	        env:
342	          # Branch-gated in bash, not in the `&&`/`||` expression below: that
343	          # pattern falls through to the staging secret whenever the main
344	          # secret happens to be empty (GH Actions treats "" as falsy), which
345	          # would silently PATCH the staging app on a main-branch deploy.
346	          IS_MAIN: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' }}
347	          COOLIFY_TOKEN_MAIN: ${{ secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN }}
348	          COOLIFY_TOKEN_STAGING: ${{ secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN_STAGING }}
349	          COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_MAIN: ${{ secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL }}
350	          COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_STAGING: ${{ secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_STAGING }}
351	        run: |
352	          if [ "$IS_MAIN" = "true" ]; then
353	            COOLIFY_TOKEN="$COOLIFY_TOKEN_MAIN"
354	            COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL="$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_MAIN"
355	          else
356	            COOLIFY_TOKEN="$COOLIFY_TOKEN_STAGING"
357	            COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL="$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_STAGING"
358	          fi
359	
360	          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" ]; then
361	            echo "::error::COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL secret is required"
362	            exit 1
363	          fi
364	
365	          # The webhook URL is Coolify's own `POST /api/v1/deploy?uuid=...`
366	          # trigger — reuse its host and uuid instead of adding new secrets.
367	          # `|| true` on each: run: steps execute under `set -e`, so a
368	          # non-matching grep (exit 1) would otherwise abort the script here
369	          # instead of reaching the explicit "could not parse" check below.
370	          COOLIFY_API_BASE=$(echo "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" | grep -oP '^https?://[^/]+' || true)
371	          COOLIFY_APP_UUID=$(echo "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" | grep -oP '(?<=[?&]uuid=)[^&]+' || true)
372	
373	          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_API_BASE" ] || [ -z "$COOLIFY_APP_UUID" ]; then
374	            echo "::error::Could not parse host/uuid out of COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL — expected .../api/v1/deploy?uuid=<uuid>. Refusing to deploy on the floating tag; fix the URL or this parsing."
375	            exit 1
376	          fi
377	
378	          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/coolify-patch-response.json -w "%{http_code}" \
379	            -X PATCH "${COOLIFY_API_BASE}/api/v1/applications/${COOLIFY_APP_UUID}" \
380	            -H "Authorization: Bearer $COOLIFY_TOKEN" \

1	FROM node:22-slim AS base
2	RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
3	  ca-certificates \
4	  curl \
5	  && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
6	WORKDIR /app
7	
8	FROM base AS deps
9	COPY package.json yarn.lock .yarnrc.yml ./
10	COPY .yarn ./.yarn
11	RUN corepack enable && yarn install --immutable
12	
13	FROM base AS builder
14	# Build-time arguments for Next.js static optimization.
15	# ARGs are scoped to the builder stage and do NOT persist in the final runner image.
16	# NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars are inlined at build time by Next.js.
17	# HMAC_SECRET is needed for ISR static generation (API route HMAC signing).
18	ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
19	ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL
20	ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN
21	ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS
22	ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS
23	ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION
24	ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS
25	ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY
26	ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI
27	ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL
28	# Web Push: public VAPID key is inlined into the client bundle at build time.
29	# Without it, usePushNotifications reports "unsupported" and the push CTA
30	# never renders in production.
31	ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
32	ARG HMAC_SECRET
33	ARG SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
34	ARG SENTRY_ORG
35	ARG SENTRY_PROJECT
36	ARG BUILD_VERSION
37	# Use ENV so child processes (yarn build) inherit the values.
38	# These ENVs only exist in the builder stage, not the final runner stage.
39	ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=$NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL \
40	    NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=$NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL \
41	    NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN=$NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN \
42	    NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS=$NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS \
43	    NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS=$NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS \
44	    NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION=$NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION \
45	    NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS=$NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS \
46	    NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY=$NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY \
47	    NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI=$NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI \
48	    NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL=$NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTACT_EMAIL \
49	    NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=$NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY \
50	    HMAC_SECRET=$HMAC_SECRET \
51	    SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN=$SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN \
52	    SENTRY_ORG=$SENTRY_ORG \
53	    SENTRY_PROJECT=$SENTRY_PROJECT \
54	    BUILD_VERSION=$BUILD_VERSION

56	COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
57	COPY . .
58	RUN corepack enable && yarn prebuild && yarn build
59	
60	FROM base AS runner
61	ENV NODE_ENV=production
62	# Re-declare BUILD_VERSION ARG to pass it from builder to runner stage.
63	# This is the only non-secret value that needs to persist in the final image.
64	ARG BUILD_VERSION

69	  && useradd --system --uid 1001 --gid nodejs nextjs

72	COPY --chown=nextjs:nodejs --from=builder /app/.next/static ./.next/static
73	COPY --chown=nextjs:nodejs --from=builder /app/public ./public

86	# Timeout was 3s — too tight for a Node.js app under GC pressure. Under
87	# memory stress the event loop stalls and /api/health can't respond within 3s
88	# even though the process is alive, triggering false-unhealthy restarts.
89	# 10s gives GC headroom; start-period 40s covers cold-start (entrypoint heap
90	# sizing + 0-byte image cache cleanup + Redis connect). The stale-cache purge

93	HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=40s --retries=3 \

1	#!/bin/sh
2	# Size V8's old-space heap to a fraction of the container's memory limit so the
3	# garbage collector runs *before* the kernel OOM-kills the container.
4	#
5	# Why this exists:
6	#   - Node 22 is cgroup-aware and defaults the heap to ~50% of the container
7	#     limit, which underuses the cap. We bump that to 75%.
8	#   - We must use an ABSOLUTE MiB value, not Node's `=NN%` syntax: the percentage
9	#     form reads the *host's* memory, not the cgroup limit, so on a shared box it
10	#     would massively oversize the heap (Red Hat cgroups v2 guidance).
11	#   - Reading the live cgroup limit means this auto-adapts to whatever limit
12	#     Coolify is set to — no rebuild needed when the limit changes.
13	#
14	# Overridable: if NODE_OPTIONS already pins --max-old-space-size (e.g. set as a
15	# Coolify env var), we leave it untouched. If no memory limit is configured, we
16	# fall back to Node's own defaults.
17	set -e
18	
19	HEAP_PERCENT=75
20	
21	if [ -z "${NODE_OPTIONS:-}" ] || ! printf '%s' "$NODE_OPTIONS" | grep -q 'max-old-space-size'; then
22	  limit_bytes=""
23	  if [ -r /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max ]; then
24	    # cgroups v2
25	    limit_bytes=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max)
26	  elif [ -r /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes ]; then
27	    # cgroups v1
28	    limit_bytes=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes)
29	  fi
30	
31	  # Reject non-numeric ("max" on v2) and unbounded sentinels (huge v1 value).
32	  case "$limit_bytes" in
33	    "" | *[!0-9]*) limit_bytes="" ;;
34	  esac
35	
36	  # Treat anything above 64 GiB as "effectively no limit" → use Node defaults.
37	  if [ -n "$limit_bytes" ] && [ "$limit_bytes" -le 68719476736 ]; then
38	    # Convert to MiB before scaling so the intermediate stays small (no overflow
39	    # on 32-bit shells); sub-MiB precision loss is irrelevant for a heap size.
40	    # shellcheck disable=SC2017
41	    limit_mib=$(( limit_bytes / 1024 / 1024 ))
42	    heap_mb=$(( limit_mib * HEAP_PERCENT / 100 ))
43	    # Skip absurdly small caps where a forced heap would do more harm than good.
44	    if [ "$heap_mb" -ge 256 ]; then
45	      export NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:+$NODE_OPTIONS }--max-old-space-size=${heap_mb}"
46	      echo "[entrypoint] cgroup limit detected; NODE_OPTIONS=$NODE_OPTIONS"
47	    fi
48	  fi
49	fi
50	
51	# Delete any 0-byte files left in the Next.js image-optimizer disk cache.
52	#
53	# A killed write (OOM kill, forced restart) can leave a 0-byte file under
54	# .next/cache/images. On the next request that touches the disk cache,
55	# Next.js reads that file's size as 0 and feeds it to its internal LRUCache,
56	# which throws ("size must be > 0") and disables image caching for the rest
57	# of the process's life (every image gets re-optimized from scratch instead
58	# of served from cache). There is no volume mounted for .next/cache, so a
59	# plain container restart (as opposed to a fresh image pull) reuses the same
60	# writable layer and the leftover file re-triggers the bug immediately on
61	# boot. Upstream bug, unfixed as of Next.js 16.2.10 / 16.3.0-canary.75:
62	# https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/93757
63	if [ -d .next/cache/images ]; then
64	  find .next/cache/images -type f -size 0 -delete ||
65	    echo "[entrypoint] warning: failed to clean zero-byte image cache files" >&2
66	fi
67	
68	exec node server.js

I've read all three changed files in full. Let me analyze:

**`.github/workflows/deploy-coolify.yml`**: The change replaces `github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.X || secrets.Y` with an explicit bash if/else. This is actually a security-hardening FIX: the old `&&`/`||` pattern silently falls through to the staging secret when the main secret is empty (documented in the comment). Now branch selection is deterministic in bash.

Cross-checks:
- Both MAIN and STAGING secrets are now always loaded into the step env. Since GitHub redacts secrets in logs and no `run:` step echoes env, no leak path exists.
- `${{ github.sha }}` interpolated into curl `--data` JSON: it's a 40-char hex commit SHA, no injection risk.
- `COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL` is a trusted repo/environment secret used in curl and grep — no attacker-influenceable path.
- `|| true` on the greps is correct — the downstream `[ -z ... ]` check catches empty output and aborts before use.
- Sibling parity: both the "Pin" and "Trigger" steps received the same bash if/else fix; the "Wait" step doesn't use these secrets and is correctly branch-gated via `env.DEPLOY_URL`.
- `deploy` job has `environment: production/staging` gating, preserving required-reviewer protections.

**`Dockerfile`**: Only a HEALTHCHECK comment was updated. No behavior change, no security impact.

**`docker-entrypoint.sh`**: Wraps the `find … -delete` in an `if [ -d ]` guard and replaces `2>/dev/null || true` with a stderr warning. `find` doesn't follow symlinks by default and `-type f` restricts to regular files; the script runs pre-`exec` as the `nextjs` UID inside the container. No new attack surface — this is a resilience improvement.

No security vulnerabilities introduced by this change.
